name: Shore Thing Grooming
address: 8317 Front Beach Rd Ste 29B, Panama City Beach, FL 32407
headline: Beach-town grooming with a lot of love
subheadline: Doodles, poodles and pups of every kind in Panama City Beach. 4.8 stars from 64 Google reviews.
intro_title: The nicest people, and they love dogs
intro: Shore Thing Grooming is a busy Panama City Beach salon on Front Beach Road. Clients say the groomers are kind and calm with anxious dogs, skilled with doodle and poodle cuts, and fairly priced.

services.name: Full groom & haircut
services.desc: Breed cuts and custom styles, including doodles and poodles.

services.name: Nail trims
services.desc: Careful trims to keep paws comfortable.

services.name: Ear & eye cleaning
services.desc: Gentle hygiene care that keeps pups healthy.

praise.title: Great with anxious dogs
praise.text: Reviewers say nervous pups are treated with patience and love.

praise.title: Doodle and poodle pros
praise.text: Owners rave about poodle trims and doodle cuts.

praise.title: Fair pricing
praise.text: Clients mention fair prices for excellent work.

praise.title: Healthy, happy dogs
praise.text: One client's vet said the dog's skin, fur and ears looked perfect.
